# Contract: best-effort shares (050)

No route is added or removed, and nothing writes the setting (FR-002). These are the observable changes.

## API (OpenAPI, regenerated by `pnpm api:openapi`)

| Schema | Change |
|--------|--------|
| `ShareSummary` (`GET /decks/{id}/shares`, `GET /shares/{id}`) | new required `savedAsSent: boolean`: the share was saved as sent because smart share is off for the sharer. Strict schema stays strict. `false` for extracted shares, file shares and shares still processing. |
| `ReviewEntry.job` (`GET /decks/{id}/review`) | `extractionFallback` enum widens to `'preview' \| 'no_smart_share'` (nullable as before); new required `extractionBodyCut: boolean`. |
| `IngestJob.extraction` (`GET /ingest/{id}`, debug view) | `fallback` widens the same way; optional `bodyCut`. |

`POST /ingest`, `/shares/{id}/retry`, the email webhook and every cap are unchanged, including the 503 when no provider is configured.

## Web copy

- Share row (`share-row__hint`, shown when `savedAsSent`): "Saved as you sent it. Smart share is coming soon."
- Review card (`fallbackLine`, `no_smart_share`): "Saved as the sharer sent it, without smart share. Check it before publishing." and, when `extractionBodyCut`, " The text was cut at the limit."

## Decision event

`ingest.extraction_skipped` (component `ingest`, one JSON line, ids and counts only):

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `event` | `ingest.extraction_skipped` |
| `outcome` | `proposed` (a best-effort card exists) or `failed` (none could be built) |
| `reason` | `smart_share_off` |
| `jobId`, `deckId`, `userId` | ids |
| `channel` | `pwa`, `paste`, `shortcut`, `email` |
| `kind` | `link`, `media`, `text` or `null` |
| `itemId` | the proposal, when `proposed` |
| `cut` | the body was cut at the limit |
| `unusedPhotos` | photos not used because a web address won (0 otherwise); ids are not logged |

Never logged: titles, text, addresses, file names, emails.

## Kind rules (the builder's contract)

Input `(raw: IngestRaw, channel)`, never a file. Output kind and card:

| Channel | Share has | Kind | Title | Body |
|---------|-----------|------|-------|------|
| app, paste, Shortcut | web address | link | page title, else share title, else site name | sender's text without the address, else page description, else none |
| app, paste, Shortcut | photos, no address | media (all photos) | share title, else first line, else "Shared image" | rest of the text |
| app, paste, Shortcut | text only | text | share title, else first line | rest of the text |
| email | photo attachments | media | subject, else first line, else "Shared image" | the body |
| email | body is only a web address | link | page title, else subject, else site name | page description, else none |
| email | any other body | text | subject, else first line | the body as written |
| any | nothing usable | none → share fails (`unknown` reason) | | |

Always: `status = proposed`, no category (the default holds it), no `autoPublish`, no event card, validated by `validateProposal`.
